item.tib: sangs rgyas don yod zhags pa'i sgrub pa las dus tshod rten 'brel gsal ba'i me longs zangs zhags dmar po
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pa'i smon lam dbang gis rong bzhi/ shod brgyad 'gro don mdzad pa'i tshe/ lcags pho khyi yi lor sbas yul rgyal mo rong gi nub/ nag shod a 'dzin lung gi byang ngos/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed pa'i gnas chen/ khro chu'i brag nas gter la drangs te/ slad rab brtan phag lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes la/ rgyal mo rong gnas kyi/ lho nub sa skyongs bstan 'dzin kyi rgyal po chen po'i pho brang bsam 'grub seng ge'i rdzong gi dbu rtse la shog ser zhal bshus pa'o/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan chen por gyur cig//
